Field.Description: The message sequence number.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: The time of message transmission in Universal Time coordinated. See UTCTimestamp in FIX 5.0 SP2 specification.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when message may be duplicate of another message sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resent as a result of a ResendRequest. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: The message checksum. This must be the last field in the message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Identifier included in Test Request message to be returned in resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Required to be 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval, in seconds. An interval of 0 indicates there are no heartbeats. The maximum supported interval is 90 seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: The exchange will reject logon if this flag is 'Y'. Market Operations can reset the inbound and outbound sequence numbers on request.

Field.Description: Identifies execution details. E - OnEntry (The order immediately removed liquidity upon entry) J - NBBOJoiner (The order resulted in a quote that is joining the NBBO) S - NBBOSetter (The order resulted in a quote that is setting the NBBO) H - HiddenQuantity (The quantity executed on the order was hidden) D - DisplayedQuantity (The quantity executed on the order was displayed) M - MidpointOrder (The order is a midpoint peg order) I - ImmediateOrder (The order is a non-bookable type that must interact immediately, e.g. a market or IOC order) R - RetailOrder (The order is a retail order) m - TradeAtMidpoint (The trade occurred at the midpoint price (note: this value may NOT be included with the 'M' indicator if the midpoint peg order was constrained to its limit price at the time of the trade and unable to execute at the midpoint) P - PriceImprovement (The order received price improvement on this trade) r - TradedAgainstRetail (The trade executed on a retail order) * h - TradedAgainstHidden (The trade executed on a non-displayed order) * • Values have limited availability and may not be provided on some exchanges.
